reviews.comment: Professor Menet is honestly the best professor for taking Biol 213. He really does not trick you in exams and he makes available to you his previous exams. He does not curve so doing well on exams is a must. Your grade comes from a total of 3 midterms and a final exam. Also his french accent is very cute.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Menet is a nice guy who wants you to succeed. Grades are based solely on 3 exams and a final. He DOES NOT CURVE but gives extra credits in exams. Go to class, take notes, practice his old exam questions, and ATTEND SI!!! He always tries his best to help you out. Practice his molarity questions (it will show up on literally every exam!!)
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Menet is one of the best professors I've ever had at A&M. His tests are from things on his powerpoint, but I would highly recommend studying old tests (posts at least 5 years of previous tests and they're very similar for the most part). He has a sort of thick accent, but just sit close and pay attention! He's one of the sweetest men on campus!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The grade is only based on the 3 exams & the final. Menet is a great professor and truly cares about his students. The class is hard and you will definitely have to work for your grade, but Menet will do everything possible to help you get the grade you want. This was by far my favorite class I've taken at A&M and I wish Menet taught more classes!

Dr. Menet is a great professor and attempts to teach students the greater picture of cell biology. His accent is not trouble at all to understand. He cares about his students and hold office hours where he answers past exam questions in full. His exams are mostly short answer so you need to understand the material really well.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Menet is by far one of the best professors I have ever had. His lectures were pretty interesting and he posts powerpoint online so you can follow along and add notes which I recommend. He had office hours once a week but would stay past his hours to help students. He is an absolute gem. Definitely take him!!!!

Very kind professor who teaches the material well. His french accent does not cause any issues and he makes clear what will be tested. The previous exams are very helpful but he doesnt give extra credit/ curve. Instead he add extra points onto the tests (ex: 107 points to get on test, but max score you can get is 100). I highly recommend this prof
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: There is no extra credit and he does not round up grades. I never read the textbook, but the one time I missed class I lost material and missed a test question. You must show up to every class to do well. Study old tests. GO TO SI and/or recitation! they are life savers! He offers like 105-111/100 points on tests so i made several 100's.

Great professor! Fantastic teaching style and really cared if you actually learned the material. Had both recitations and SI which were not mandatory but was quite helpful. Also, he was always available for office hours and was overall a very respecting, nice professor. Studying from old exams helped and was very clear cut and what is tested.
Don't take BIO 213 with this professor, you will regret it.
